## Problem

A clear and concise description of what problem this feature would solve. Example: "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## Proposed Solution

Describe your preferred solution. Include API sketches, code examples, or pseudocode if helpful.

## Alternatives

Describe any alternative solutions or features you have considered.

## Additional Context

Add any other context about the feature request here, such as:
- Roadmap alignment
- Use cases
- Links to related issues or discussions
- References to similar features in other projects
